aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:872.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Team Operations and Player Care Coordinator is responsible for delivering comprehensive support and care to players and their families, acting as a key liaison between players and the technical staff. This role ensures a seamless player experience by managing all administrative and logistical needs related to the LA Galaxy. The coordinator will oversee the full lifecycle of player and staff engagement with the club—from arrival to departure—including new players, trialists, technical staff, and guests. This includes supporting onboarding, travel, accommodations, daily logistics, and ensuring all individuals are properly cared for in every aspect of their interaction with the club. Essential Functions Coordinate and support the full relocation process for new player signings, including travel, housing, banking, communications, transportation, documentation, schooling, and language lessons. Prepare and regularly update a detailed welcome package to ensure a smooth transition for players and their families. Assist in the game day experience for players and their families— coordinating logistics such as arrival, parking, ticketing, hospitality, childminding, and travel for both home and away matches. Coordinate and execute all aspects of team travel, including flights, lodging, meals, ground transportation, and logistics for training and games. Support players with media and appearance obligations in coordination with team administration and communications. Manage player mail and deliveries, including care packages, sponsor items, and fan mail. Coordinate player appearance requests by ensuring all details are clearly communicated. Plan and execute team events throughout the season. Liaise with visiting teams to coordinate all in-market logistics, including suite accommodations, tickets, parking, credentials, and training session arrangements. Work with the league office to ensure timely and accurate completion of player HR documentation, including payroll setup, benefits, insurance, and pension plans. Help organize and maintain a clean, efficient, and structured work environment, supporting colleagues in managing office, breakroom, and shared common areas. Utilize Concur to manage expense tracking, ensure budget accuracy, and deliver timely financial reports to appropriate accounting and finance contacts. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) Degree in Sport Management/Business, Social Work, or Hospitality preferred 2-4 years Experience in hospitality, real estate, customer service, VIP concierge services or professional sports is preferred Experience playing and/or working in soccer is preferred Must be willing and able to travel and have a reliable vehicle with clean driving history Team player with the ability to adapt quickly to a changing environment Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel with the ability to learn required business systems Excellent written

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:80f30323-3ac2-4a9.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/cca476c0-947e-4006-a2cb-409350de667a/7f607394-a435-4f65-a46a-ad290a1fa43b/Screenshot%202025-02-14%20at%2010.18.39%E2%80%AFAM.png] Breakthrough medicines all start the same way: years of research, mountains of data, and countless decisions made by medical teams within the world's premier biopharma labs. These decisions then determine which treatments make it to market, how doctors learn about them, and ultimately which patients get access to life-saving care and when. We're at an inflection point. AI-powered drug discovery, precision medicine, and an explosion of real-world evidence have accelerated what's possible, but the teams translating science into patient access are drowning in data they can't use. The tools haven't kept up with the stakes. Atrix builds purpose-built AI for life sciences, designed for the accuracy and rigor biopharma requires. We're live with top-10 pharmaceutical companies, scaling fast, and focused on one thing: helping the right treatments reach the right patients, sooner THE ROLE DESCRIPTION You’ll be a core builder of the Atrix AI-native platform, designing and shipping features that turn complex healthcare and AI workflows into intuitive, elegant interfaces, trusted by scientific, medical, and commercial teams across top pharma companies. From crafting thoughtful front-end UX to building robust backend systems, you’ll help bridge our AI core with real-world customer pain points, working on problems that genuinely move the needle in patient care. We’re building a modular, agentic platform that connects to customer-approved data sources, transforms messy, unstructured data using advanced AI, and delivers structured, actionable insights that drive decisions in regulated environments. You’ll see your work used daily by medical, clinical, and commercial teams making high-stakes decisions. You’ll tackle rich engineering challenges across: - Performance — We’re processing large data sets at once - Security & Privacy — Customers trust us with sensitive data - Explainability — AI outputs must be verifiable and traceable - Composable UI/UX — Interfaces need to adapt to varied use cases, from chat to dashboards to spreadsheets You’ll work closely with our Engineering Team and CEO, and collaborate as a peer to product, design, and GTM leadership. As one of our earliest Full Stack Engineers, you’ll help define technical architecture, influence product strategy, and set the tone for future engineering hires. 💡 This is an hybrid role based in NYC (ability to be in office is required), with flexibility for remote work on some days as needed. RESPONSIBILITIES This role is perfect for someone who is customer-obsessed, technically fluent, and thrives in fast-moving startup environments. If you love the challenge of translating AI workflows into intuitive product experiences in a high-stakes industry, we want to talk to you. - Own and evolve our web stack (React/Next.js + Python) to support fast, reliable AI-native workflows - Collaborate directly with product and design to shape user-facing features from spec to ship - Translate complex backend data structures into intuitive, delightful interfaces - Debug and improve frontend and backend systems to increase performance and reduce latency - Attend key customer and sales meetings to understand real-world workflows and incorporate feedback into product design - Drive architectural improvements to support scale, modularity, and developer velocity - Take full ownership of core product modules across the stack. Must haves - 5+ years experience as a fullstack or frontend-focused engineer - Previous B2B and startup experience required - Expertise in React/Next.js and frontend systems architecture - Comfortable working across the stack in Python when needed - Passionate about user experience and shipping polished, performant UIs - Proven ability to own projects end-to-end, from planning to deployment - Experience with distribut

viessmann-viessmann:ashbyhq:e408242b-bb5.description: Location: Munich Help identify exceptional founders, emerging technologies and investment opportunities that shape the future. As an Investment Associate – Early Stage Ventures, you'll help identify, evaluate and support investments in startups, venture funds and emerging technologies that shape the future of industries. Beyond identifying new opportunities, you'll work closely with our existing portfolio companies and ecosystem partners to help create long-term strategic value across the Viessmann Generations Group. From evaluating breakthrough AI companies to supporting industrial portfolio transformation and connecting founders, investors and operating businesses, you'll combine analytical rigor with sound investment judgement to help shape our future portfolio. VIESSMANN GENERATIONS GROUP As a globally active, independent family business in its fourth generation, we have been shaping living spheres for generations to come since 1917. Under the leadership of Max Viessmann, we pursue our mission with a long-term perspective and entrepreneurial spirit. The Viessmann Way https://viessmann.group/how/the-viessmann-way supports how we work, lead, and create value together - whether as a team member, entrepreneur or partner in our ecosystem. It is not a rulebook, but a compass: a living set of principles shaped by over a century of entrepreneurship and guided by our long-term purpose. THE OPPORTUNITY You'll help identify and evaluate investment opportunities that strengthen VGG's long-term portfolio—from early-stage startups and venture funds to strategic ecosystem partnerships and emerging technologies. Working closely with the investment team, you'll contribute across the full investment process by sourcing opportunities, developing investment theses, performing due diligence and preparing investment recommendations. Beyond evaluating new investment opportunities, you'll actively contribute to our existing portfolio by supporting founders, identifying strategic opportunities and helping connect companies, investors and operating businesses across the broader VGG ecosystem. We're looking for someone who brings an outside-in perspective—someone who is naturally curious, connects seemingly unrelated trends and identifies opportunities others may overlook. Success in this role requires more than strong analysis; it requires independent thinking, sound judgement and the ability to develop conviction in emerging technologies, founders and markets before they become obvious. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Discover & Evaluate Emerging Investment Opportunities - Identify promising startups aligned with VGG's investment strategy and thematic focus areas - Proactively identify emerging technologies, market shifts and investment opportunities before they become widely recognized - Conduct commercial, financial and market analysis to develop differentiated investment theses - Form independent investment opinions by combining rigorous analysis with commercial judgement and clearly articulating investment recommendations Support Investment Execution - Perform commercial, financial and strategic due diligence - Develop financial models, investment cases and decision materials that enable high-quality investment decisions - Prepare investment memoranda and support Investment Committee decision-making - Coordinate internal and external diligence workstreams throughout the transaction process Contribute to Portfolio Value Creation - Support portfolio companies by identifying strategic opportunities, partnerships and follow-on investment potential - Connect founders, portfolio companies, investors and operating businesses across the VGG ecosystem to unlock long-term value - Identify cross-portfolio insights, emerging technology trends and AI-driven opportunities that strengthen both investment decisions and portfolio performance WHAT YOU BRING - 3–5 years of experience in Venture Capital, Corporate Venture Capital, Investment Banking, Growth Equity, Strategy
